recovery.description: Look up the structured recovery envelope for a known dbcli error code, or list all codes.

use.description: Switch or display the default database connection

schema.description: Retrieve table structure or list all tables

list.description: List all tables in the database

q.description: Run a saved query snippet by @name

audit.description: Inspect, look up, clear, or check the health of the audit log

tail.description: Show recent audit entries (default: last 10 from current connection)

show.description: Look up a single audit entry by id (UUID prefix >=4) or --recovery-ref

clear.description: Delete audit log files (.jsonl + .jsonl.1) for the current connection
clear.prompt_header: About to clear audit log for connection '{conn}':
clear.requires_tty_or_yes: Cannot prompt for confirmation in non-interactive session. Use --yes to clear without prompt.

health.description: Show AuditLogger health snapshot (size, entries, lock state, last write)

write_gate.no_decisions: Tier two was never reached in this window. Per ADR 0010 that falsifies the criterion, not the gate: the shapes it looks for are not the shapes people write.
write_gate.no_entries: The audit log is empty, so this says nothing about the gate either way. Run some writes, or check `dbcli audit health`.

audit.disabled_hint: Audit is disabled (audit.enabled = false in .dbcli). Use 'dbcli audit health' for details.
audit.show_ambiguous: Ambiguous prefix '{prefix}': matches {count} entries. Please use a longer prefix.
audit.show_prefix_too_short: Prefix must be at least 4 characters.
audit.show_recovery_ambiguous: Multiple entries reference recovery_ref '{ref}': matches {count}. This should be rare; inspect file directly.
audit.show_mutex_violation: Provide either <id> argument or --recovery-ref, not both.

queries.no_snippets: No snippets found. Create one with: dbcli queries new @<name>
queries.search_no_keywords: Provide at least one keyword, or try 'queries list' / 'queries suggest'.
queries.search_no_results: No snippets matched. Try 'queries list' or 'queries suggest <intent>'.
queries.suggest_no_results: No snippets with intent prefix '{intent}'. Available: {available}
queries.no_active_connection_hint: No active connection; showing snippets across all engines.

errors.permission_requires_level: {type} operation requires {minimum} permission or higher (current level: {permission})
errors.elasticsearch_requires_level: Elasticsearch {type} operation requires {minimum} permission or higher (current level: {permission})
errors.escalated_write_requires_admin: This statement opens as a read but contains an executable {keyword}. A write hidden inside a read statement requires admin permission (current level: {permission}).
errors.multiple_statements_refused: SQL containing multiple statements is refused below admin permission, because only the first statement determines the permission check. Run each statement separately.
errors.unknown_statement_query_only: Unrecognised SQL statement (current level: query-only). Security policy requires read-write+ for unknown statements. If this is a legitimate read-only statement, please open an issue at https://github.com/CarlLee1983/dbcli/issues.
errors.table_blacklisted: Error: Table '{table}' is blacklisted for {operation} operations
errors.column_blacklisted_write: Error: {operation} on table '{table}' touches blacklisted columns: {columns}
errors.table_not_in_blacklist: Error: Table '{table}' is not in the blacklist
errors.column_not_in_blacklist: Error: Column '{table}.{column}' is not in the blacklist
errors.env_refs_missing_options:
When using --use-env-refs, environment variable names must be specified.
Provide options: --env-host, --env-port, --env-user, --env-password, --env-database
Or use interactive mode: run "dbcli init --use-env-refs" without --no-interactive
errors.env_var_not_defined:
Cannot test connection: environment variable {envKey} is not defined.
Set {envKey} in .env or environment variables.
Hint: run 'export {envKey}=<value>' and retry
errors.invalid_output_format: --format {format} is not supported here — use text or json

insert.elasticsearch_unsupported: Elasticsearch does not support the insert command; for now, use an external tool (e.g. curl or Kibana DevTools) to write documents

delete.admin_only: Delete command requires data-admin or admin permission
delete.elasticsearch_unsupported: Elasticsearch does not support the delete command; for now, use an external tool (e.g. curl or Kibana DevTools) to delete documents

password.description: Change the password of a single connection, leaving every other setting untouched
password.arg_connection: Connection name (defaults to the current default connection)
password.opt_stdin: Read the new password from stdin (for rotation scripts)
password.opt_password: New password given inline (visible in shell history and process list)
password.opt_skip_test: Skip verifying the new password against the database before saving
password.source_conflict: --password and --stdin cannot be used together; pick one source.
password.needs_source: No terminal available for a masked prompt. Pass the value with --stdin or --password.
password.empty: The new password is empty; nothing was changed.
password.converted: The literal password in config.json was replaced by a {{ "$env": "{varName}" }} reference; later rotations only touch the env file.
password.skipped_test: Verification skipped (--skip-test): the new password was not checked against the database.
